content.value_statement: Email programs can lose inbox placement because authentication, reputation, or list data is incomplete. This skill organizes supplied evidence into a pre-send deliverability report with clear gaps and next steps.
actual_capabilities: Reviews supplied SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and BIMI evidence for alignment and gaps.
Classifies authentication, reputation, inbox placement, content, and hygiene items as Pass, Partial, Fail, Unknown, or N/A.
Flags missing DMARC reports and missing seed-list tests as required evidence.
Reviews supplied creative HTML for spam phrases, link issues, text balance, and rendering risks.
Summarizes hard-bounce and spam-complaint data from a point-in-time ESP report.
Produces a SEND-S readiness summary when all applicable evidence is available.
limitations: It cannot prove mail authentication passes without DNS and DMARC aggregate evidence.
It does not provide recurring list-hygiene trend monitoring.
It does not calculate the full email quality score or make final send veto decisions.
Connector scripts referenced by the skill require separate review and approval before use.

use_cases.title: Pre-send campaign review
use_cases.description: Check authentication and inbox-placement evidence before a marketing campaign launches.

use_cases.title: New sending-domain validation
use_cases.description: Identify missing SPF, DKIM, DMARC, or BIMI evidence during a domain setup.

use_cases.title: Deliverability incident triage
use_cases.description: Organize reputation, complaint, bounce, and creative evidence after spam-folder placement.

prompt_templates.title: Start a basic pre-flight
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a deliverability pre-flight for my sending domain. Tell me which evidence you need first.

prompt_templates.title: Check authentication records
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and BIMI records for example.com. Mark each item Pass, Partial, Fail, or Unknown.

prompt_templates.title: Assess a campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my DMARC report, inbox-placement test, ESP bounce and complaint rates, and email HTML. Give me a pre-send checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Create a readiness handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Using this deliverability evidence for a promotional program, produce a complete SEND-S summary. List missing evidence and do not score incomplete items.

output_examples.input: Review these SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records before my newsletter send.
output: DMARC: Partial because policy is p=none
Next step: provide a DMARC aggregate report and inbox-placement test.

output_examples.input: My seed test shows spam placement and complaints are 0.35 percent. What should I do?
output: Pause the send and investigate complaints, authentication alignment, and creative content.

best_practices: Provide current DNS records, a DMARC aggregate report, and a seed-list test together.
Use evidence from the same sending domain and campaign period.
Treat Unknown items as evidence gaps instead of passing them by default.
anti_patterns: Do not score readiness when required evidence is missing.
Do not treat a DNS record as proof that messages pass authentication.
Do not use this one-time review as a replacement for ongoing list monitoring.

faq.question: What evidence should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide DNS records, a DMARC aggregate report, inbox-placement results, and an ESP deliverability report when available.

faq.question: Does this skill send email?
faq.answer: No. It reviews evidence and prepares a pre-send readiness report.

faq.question: Can it check SPF, DKIM, and DMARC?
faq.answer: Yes. It reviews supplied records and DMARC evidence for presence, alignment, and reported passing status.

faq.question: Does it make the final send decision?
faq.answer: No. It flags S1 evidence and prepares a SEND-S summary for the email quality auditor.

faq.question: Can it monitor bounce rates over time?
faq.answer: No. It reads a point-in-time snapshot. Use a dedicated hygiene monitor for recurring trends.

faq.question: Are connector commands required?
faq.answer: No. The skill supports manual exports and keyless checks. Review and approve any connector command before running it.
